title: Pelatihan Tadarus 5T
lead: Training for preachers and Qur'an teachers who are being prepared as trainers or teachers of Tadarus with the 5T method.
whatsapp:
Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullah wabarakatuh.

I would like to ask about the Pelatihan Tadarus 5T (training).

audience.label: For
audience.value: Heads of institutions, preachers, Qur'an teachers & practitioners

general.title: General goals
items: Understanding how the Prophet and his companions studied the Qur'an together.
Being able to apply the 5T method in a Tadarus circle.

topics: The basis of the 5T method in the Qur'an and hadith
The Tadarus of the Prophet and his companions

method.title: How we train
items: Questions and answers between trainer and participants.
Tadarus over WhatsApp of surah ad-Duha.

funding.title: Costs
items: Transport, accommodation and learning materials are covered by the host.
Markaz Tadarus Indonesia welcomes infaq and sadaqah to support spreading Tadarus 5T.

coaching.title: Follow-up
items: After the training, coaching continues online, arranged with the host as needed.

certificate.title: E-certificate of participation
certificate.text: Every trainee receives an e-certificate (PDF) in the official Markaz Tadarus Indonesia design, like this one.
